requirement: Deleting a site gives its Docker network and /24 back to the host, after its SMTP rule and under the allocator lock

oracle.ref: PR #893 (fix); fix evidence: 05/10/2026 on the dev Mac stand: 183 `<label>_default` networks, 182 of the 256 /24 subnets under 10.240.0.0/16 taken, most with no container; every test site deleted through the delete door left its network.
oracle.invariant: S1 exits 0 with '# fail 0' and '# pass' equal to '# tests' (at least 19). The named case is 'ok': after the teardown only the neighbour's network is left, `network rm <label>_default` comes after the subnet's `iptables -C` in the call log, and a network docker refuses to remove is reported with docker's reason, the teardown exits 1 with no success marker saying 'did not finish: the site network <label>_default is still on this host' and keeps its log, and a later teardown takes the network once it is free (it used to succeed and leave it; changed by PR #988).
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)

assertionIds: the site's own network goes with it, and only that one; a network still in use is a teardown that did not finish
tests: the site's own network goes with it, and only that one; a network still in use is a teardown that did not finish
